name: tish-extension
description: Language support for Tish (including JSX in .tish) — syntax highlighting, snippets, tasks; language server (downloads prebuilt tish-lsp; no local compiler required)

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In Restricted Mode, workspace-defined language-server download settings are ignored. Syntax highlighting and a locally configured tish-lsp (user settings, PATH, or TISH_LANGUAGE_SERVER_PATH) still work; trust the workspace to allow workspace download overrides.

tish.debug.extension.description: Log extension-side lifecycle and tish-lsp resolution to Output → “Tish Extension” with [tish-ext ISO8601 …] prefixes (boot lines always appear there). “Tish Language Server” is for the server process, downloads, and tish.trace.server. Toggle: “Tish: Toggle Extension Debug Logging”.

tish.languageServerPath.description: Optional path to a prebuilt tish-lsp executable. When empty, the extension downloads the matching binary from GitHub Releases (see language server download settings). When set, this overrides automatic download, TISH_LANGUAGE_SERVER_PATH, dev sibling lookup, and PATH. You may use ${workspaceFolder} or ${workspaceFolder:Name} (multi-root .code-workspace); they are expanded to absolute paths before spawn.

tish.languageServerDownload.enable.description: Download a prebuilt tish-lsp from GitHub Releases on first use and cache it under global storage (recommended; no Rust/cargo install needed).

tish.languageServerDownload.repo.description: GitHub repo owner/name for binaries (default: value from extension package.json tishLsp.downloadRepo).

tish.languageServerDownload.releaseTag.description: Release tag to download (default: package.json tishLsp.releaseTag).

tish.languageServerDownload.url.description: Full URL to tish-lsp binary (overrides repo/tag asset lookup).

tish.trace.server.description: Trace LSP communication (Output → Tish Language Server).

tish.format.enable.description: Format document on save via tish-lsp. Off by default: the formatter re-emits the AST and does not preserve comments; JSX is re-laid out (may differ from your style). Turn on only when you want normalized output.

tish.tishlangSourceRoot.description: Absolute path to your local `tishlang/tish` repository root (directory that contains `crates/`). When set, Go to Definition on built-in globals (e.g. `setTimeout`, `console`), `Math.*` / `JSON.*`, and JSX intrinsic tags (e.g. `<div>`) jumps to the corresponding Rust sources; hover on those globals includes a clickable link to the same target. Same as the `TISHLANG_SOURCE_ROOT` environment variable for the language server process.
